source.title: Custom Packaging Boxes: Design your Own with PackMojo | PackMojo PackMojo
source.description: Create premium product boxes & unique custom packaging tailored to your business needs. Build branded designs that leave a lasting impression with PackMojo.
source.content:
Custom boxes & packaging for brands of all sizes
Hassle-free solutions that make it easy to transform the unboxing experience.
Low Minimums
Start with as few as 100 units. Perfect for testing new packaging concepts or seasonal campaigns without overcommitting.
Fully Customizable
From simple logo prints to intricate patterns inside and out. Every detail of your packaging is yours to design.
Sustainable by Default
FSC-certified materials, recycled content, and soy-based inks. Premium packaging that respects the planet.
Expert Guidance
Tailored recommendations from packaging specialists who understand your products and brand vision.
How it works
Three simple steps from idea to finished product.
Choose & Customize
Browse 40+ packaging types. Pick your box style and customize dimensions, materials, printing, and finishing.
Sample & Approve
Receive a physical sample of your custom packaging. Make refinements until it's perfect.
Produce & Deliver
We handle production, quality checks, and worldwide shipping. Ready in 12–16 business days (plus shipping).
Who We Serve
For growing brands & enterprises
Robust solutions and dedicated support that scale with your growth.
Quality assurance
From designers and prepress technicians, to operators and quality control inspectors, all parties work in harmony and follow stringent quality control processes to produce high-quality products in every production run.
Packaging engineering
Our team of engineers can help you develop custom packaging structures that optimize material and space, while providing the protection and security your products need in transit.
Scalability & reliability
Whether you need 500 or 500,000 units produced, our production capacity can scale limitlessly to meet your operational demands.
Dedicated account manager
Get priority support, one-on-one expert guidance, and ongoing consulting for current and future business needs.
Popular custom boxes & printed packaging solutions
The Platform
Your entire packaging workflow, streamlined
No more back-and-forth emails and confusing spreadsheets. The PackMojo platform gives you complete control from quote to delivery.
Configure your packaging
Choose from 40+ product types. Customize size, materials, print, and finishes to match your brand perfectly.
Get instant quotes & samples
Compare multi-quantity quotes side by side. Order reimbursable samples to validate your design before production.
Flexible shipping options
Air or ocean freight, split shipments, multiple destinations. Choose the logistics that work for your timeline and budget.
Track everything in one place
Download dielines, upload artwork, track production progress, and manage reorders - all from your dashboard.
Eco-friendly packaging solutions
We're committed to offsetting our world's carbon footprint, contributing to reforestation, and sustainability. Not only do we offer packaging that's FSC™ certified, all of our premium product boxes is made from recycled materials and printed with soy-based ink.
